---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a workflow improvement with a clear outcome and acceptance criteria
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

<!-- Search existing requests first. Keep examples and mockups synthetic.
Do not include patient information, real sample identifiers, credentials, or private data. -->

## Problem and affected workflow

Describe who needs the change, what they are trying to achieve, and where the
current workflow falls short. Include the frequency or cost of the problem when known.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behavior from the user's perspective. Avoid prescribing an
implementation unless it is required by a clinical or technical constraint.

## Scope and constraints

- In scope:
- Out of scope:
- Constraints or dependencies: <!-- Compatibility, access, clinical rules, configuration, or deployment. -->

State whether the proposal would change finding selection, interpretation,
classification, report content, or saved report history. Explain the intended
behavior if it would; write "no change" or "unknown" otherwise.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable outcomes a reviewer can verify, including relevant failure or
permission boundaries. Replace the example below with criteria for this request.

- [ ] Given [starting context], when [action], then [observable result].

## Alternatives and workarounds

Describe the current workaround and alternatives considered. Explain why they do
not adequately solve the problem.

## Additional context

Link related issues, documentation, synthetic mockups, or applicable standards.
Describe any timing constraint and its reason; requested dates do not establish
a delivery commitment.
